# Book Development Status {.unnumbered}

This book is being developed alongside the Fall 2026 offering of
ME/BME 736: Advanced Finite Element Methods. The status below indicates how
much of each chapter has been developed and reviewed. It will be updated as the
book progresses.

For this page, **complete** means that a chapter has a full working draft
suitable for use in the course. Complete chapters may still receive
copyediting, additional examples, improved exercises, and revisions needed for
consistency with later chapters.

## Complete

- **Chapter 1: Introduction to the Finite Element Method**
- **Chapter 2: Mathematical Foundations**
- **Chapter 3: Partial Differential Equations and Variational Formulations**
- **Chapter 4: Model Problems in Heat Transfer and Solid Mechanics**
- **Chapter 5: The Finite Element Method in One Dimension**
- **Chapter 6: Finite Element Approximation in Multiple Dimensions**
- **Chapter 7: A Priori Error Estimation and Convergence**
- **Chapter 8: A Posteriori Error Estimation and Adaptive Finite Elements**

## Yet to be started

The material through a posteriori error estimation and adaptivity has been
covered in the course. The remaining three chapters are planned in the
following order and currently contain placeholders:

- **[Chapter 9: Nonlinear Finite Element Methods](chapters/11-nonlinear-fem.qmd)**
- **[Chapter 10: Transient Finite Element Methods](chapters/12-transient-fem.qmd)**
- **[Chapter 11: PDE-Constrained Optimization](chapters/13-pde-constrained-optimization.qmd)**

Last updated: October 28, 2026.
